response.sql:
WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'NO_STATE') as state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) as customer_count
  FROM Customers c
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Accounts a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id)
  GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'NO_STATE')
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    customer_count,
    customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () as share
  FROM state_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM state_shares
),
above_average_states AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    customer_count,
    share
  FROM state_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(customer_count) as combined_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)) as average_excess
FROM above_average_states;

assumptions.assumption: Customers with NULL state_county_province are grouped together as 'NO_STATE', forming their own distinct group in the analysis
Only customers appearing in the Accounts table (those with at least one account) are counted per state
'Plain average' refers to the arithmetic mean

alternatives.interpretation: Treat customers with NULL state_county_province as a NULL group value rather than converting to the string 'NO_STATE', preserving the NULL representation in results
